class.description: The passthrough node calls the optional user-defined tick-method and then calls the tick-method of its child node, returning what ever the child node tick result is. If no child node has been defined, it returns what ever you choose for the tick-result. The user-defined tick-method is optional; when it returns a Status, that result is stored as this node's tick-result only when there is no enabled child node to tick. Otherwise the child node's result is stored and returned. You can use this node to do preparations for a behaviour tree branch, for instance calculate some angles or distances that all the nodes within a branch will be using and putting them to blackboard.
